_doctrine: All 19 audit-trail rows for the 19 over-predict T11/T12 candidates. Every fu_correction_liver=1.0 (cv=0.0) is identity → registry preserves the Phase A bit-identical Meta AAFE 2.7715 baseline. Per spec §6.2 DE-37 escape clause (2026-05-22-B11-Phase-B-curation-log.md §T12): all 4 PPB candidates dispositioned ceiling_accepted because the primary-corpus papers are paywalled (Watanabe 2009 / Yamazaki 2010 / Riccardi 2017 / Patilea-Vrana 2017) and the supplemental tables (where per-drug fu_inc/fu_p ratios live) are not retrievable from public WebFetch. The 15 not_applicable entries document the mechanism reasons for non-curation. No literature_applied or class_extrapolated rows are introduced in this cycle.

overrides.notes: PPB candidate (clinical fup<0.01 vs predicted 0.147, hepatic SULT2A1 + CYP3A4 dominant). Primary corpus abstracts only; supplemental tables paywalled. Steroidal SULT2A1 substrate class is weakly represented in the OATP/ECCS-cation primary corpus scope, so even with subscription access, positive hit probability is low. Secondary PubMed search returned Goldwater 2017 (PMID:28107519) and Bohnert 2013 PBPK (PMID:23396310) using clinical fup without measured fu_inc.

overrides.notes: PPB candidate (fup=0.04, hepatic CYP3A4-dominant, F~10% with CV>100%). Primary corpus abstracts only; supplemental tables paywalled. Neutral steroidal hormone with transcortin/SHBG binding is structurally orthogonal to the OATP-substrate and ECCS-cation-base primary corpus scope. Transcortin/SHBG binding is bidirectional plasma binding, not the unidirectional albumin-facilitated hepatic uptake that B-11 captures. Secondary PubMed returned PMID:8513955 (Simon 1993 clinical CL) without measured fu_inc.
source_dbs_searched: Patilea-Vrana & Unadkat 2017 Clin Pharmacokinet (abstract only; body paywalled)

overrides.notes: Out of AD (HIGH_MW + EXTREME_LIPOPHILIC + PGP_EFFLUX_RISK). Primary clearance is intestinal P-gp secretion (31-60% unchanged drug in feces), not hepatic-CYP. PPB correction cannot address P-gp efflux mechanism. Mechanism: transporter (P-gp intestinal secretion).
Renal excretion dominant (no CYP/UGT involvement). No hepatic CL pathway to correct. fup=0.58 also excludes PPB criterion. Mechanism: route (renal).
CES1 hydrolysis ~85% of clearance (not CYP). High fup (0.95) excludes PPB criterion. CES1 not in enzyme_affinity registry. Mechanism: enzyme not registered.

Extreme first-pass (F=4-10%) dominates. Predicted fup=0.42 above PPB threshold (literature inconsistent: StatPearls 0.10-0.15 vs DrugBank 0.005). Primary mechanism is bioavailability, not PPB. Mechanism: first-pass / F estimation.
Enteric-coated delayed-release formulation engineered for F~9% local IBD action. Formulation-specific bioavailability dominates the 15x fold error. Mechanism: formulation / first-pass.

PRODRUG (AD-out). Parent fup=0.03 but circulating active metabolite 5-HMT has fup~0.50 (not PPB-related by criteria). Parent vs metabolite Cmax reference entity mismatch. Mechanism: prodrug entity mismatch.

fup=0.22 above PPB threshold. Primary mechanism: CYP1A2 mechanism-based autoinhibition (fluvoxamine potently inhibits its own metabolizer). Time-dependent inhibition not modeled by engine. Mechanism: enzyme autoinhibition.
Predicted fup=0.15 borderline; clinical fup~0.20 above PPB threshold. Strongly basic (pKa~9) drug; likely lysosomal trapping inflating Vd. Mechanism: distribution (lysosomal trapping).
fup=0.18 above PPB threshold. Extreme oral first-pass (F=1.8%) dominates the 6x fold error. Primary mechanism: bioavailability. Mechanism: first-pass / F estimation.

Parent fup=0.22 above PPB threshold. CES1 hydrolyzes 85% of absorbed drug (parent disposition). Already addressed by separate B-03 prodrug spec (2026-05-20-clopidogrel-prodrug-design.md). Mechanism: prodrug + CES1 hydrolysis (separate spec).

Out of AD (HIGH_MW + PGP_EFFLUX_RISK). UGT1A4 glucuronidation primary (not CYP). Oral suspension has gastric-pH-dependent precipitation + erratic absorption. Mechanism: absorption / formulation + P-gp.
fup=0.86 well above PPB threshold. Primary clearance is MAO-A oxidation, which is not in the CYP-based enzyme_affinity registry. Mechanism: enzyme not registered (MAO-A).

fup=0.98 well above PPB threshold. Cleared by spontaneous chemical hydrolysis + cytidine deaminase (not CYP/UGT). Oral ONUREG formulation F~11-13%. Mechanism: enzyme not registered (cytidine deaminase) + formulation.
fup=0.73 well above PPB threshold. Modest 3.8x fold error likely from CYP2D6 EM/PM population variability or IR vs ER formulation. Mechanism: pharmacogenomic variability.

fup=0.65 well above PPB threshold. UGT2B7-dominant glucuronidation; UGT2B7 representation in enzyme_affinity registry is a separate gap. Already routed via SBI+reweight production override. Mechanism: enzyme registration + routing override.
